findings.text: [P3] the substitution control subtracts a simple-cut-only reduction term from the sister report's whole-plasma booked current, so on the diverted row it removes 1892.94 A against a 1710.08 A membership deficit and returns 1.004899883 above unity; nothing asserts this run's total booked current equals the sister report's, so a drift between the two runs would leave the control green.

[P3] the interior positive control's secondary_geometry and reclip_self_intersection_loss ratios are identically zero by construction because interior cells are not reclipped, so the below 1e-9 control exercises only the density and reduction terms and cannot redden on a geometry or self-intersection instrument defect.

[P3] the simple separatrix-cut cell set is inherited from the sister report's per-cell class and non_simple flags rather than re-derived from this run's own reclip output, so the census boundary comes from another node's classification, though the closure cross-check ties the subset totals to within 5.79e-14.

limits: Read-only review; no test or H200 job was rerun. The accepted receipt job.log (revision 2b803b2ff, EXIT=0) and the committed per-row receipts were read and audited.

The independent reference shares the production effective polygon, field and confined profile and forms its own Duffy points; it never calls the production reduction, which is what makes the moment-reduction term a measurement rather than a tautology.

The reference was revised in 2b803b2ff after job 1277106 exited zero; the revision is disclosed in the evidence record and replaces a double pointwise selector with the production confined closure, but both the diagnosis and the accepted run come from the same worker.

The four-term closure is an algebraic telescoping identity; the non-trivial half is the agreement of the sum with the sister report's simple_moment_integration_error_a, which is pinned by sha256 and closes within 5.79e-14.

The diverted substituted fraction is 1.004899883, above unity; the done_when only requires 0.999 on the weak rows, and the overshoot follows from the mixed arithmetic scope recorded in the first finding.
report.json is 9.5 MB and the per-row receipts run to 181k lines; the open followup f-cca-slim-committed-attribution-receipts already covers this.
